title: Legesher Language Registry
description: Schema for the canonical language metadata registry used across all Legesher packages

canonical_language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the canonical/source language (the language programming keywords are written in)

languages.description: Map of ISO 639-1 codes to language metadata

native.description: Native name of the language in its own script

rtl.description: Whether the language uses right-to-left script

has_case_distinction.description: Whether the language's primary script distinguishes upper/lowercase. False for Arabic-family, CJK, Brahmic, SE-Asian, and Ge'ez scripts; true for Latin, Cyrillic, Greek. Used by PromptBuilder (CORE-950) to substitute snake_case for PascalCase identifiers when the script can't represent case.

numeral_system.description: CLDR numbering-system identifier of the digits the language writes natively: CLDR's native system for the locale when it is a Unicode decimal-digit block ('arab' for Arabic-Indic, 'arabext' for Persian and Urdu, 'deva' for Devanagari), otherwise 'latn' for ASCII 0-9. The ten digits derive from it (legesher_i18n.numerals).

decimal_separator.description: Decimal mark written with the native digits: CLDR's decimal symbol for the locale's native system (U+066B for Arabic, Persian and Urdu). A language that writes ASCII digits records '.', the mark a numeric literal in code uses.

status.description: Availability status of the language pack
